name: mkdir
description: Creates one or more directories. By default, the parent directory must already exist and mkdir fails if the directory already exists.

options.description: Also creates missing parent directories, with no error if the directory already exists.
Sets the permissions of the new directory (like chmod).
Prints a message for each directory created.

arguments.name: DIRECTORY
arguments.description: Path of the directory (or directories) to create.

examples.explanation: Creates the photos directory in the current directory.
Creates the whole tree in one go, parents included.
Creates a directory only its owner can access.
Creates a then a/b, printing each creation.
examples.output:
mkdir: created directory 'a'
mkdir: created directory 'a/b'
